metadata.title: How to make Axone at home
metadata.description:
Soft cooked soybeans are fermented inside a bamboo basket with a lining of banana leaves, Phrynium leaves, fern fronds or even ficus tree leaves and left by fireplace. 

The action of microbes mainly the bacillus subtilis gives it a unique stringy feel and texture. The beans fermented this way is a powerhouse of nutrients as it has easily absorb-able high digest protein and is quite inexpensive. 

Lets Connect!
